rules: No local boolean, draft, hash, queue state, or portal observation clears a legal, certification, submission, or award gate.
A gate marked CLEARED requires a portal-issued record, agency determination, or qualified legal review declared as clearance evidence.
Private evidence paths are replaced by opaque private references in generated outputs.
Closed routes remain closed; the audit never recommends a late or duplicate submission.
A submission receipt is distinct from a portal preview, an account registration, and an award or acceptance notice.
SAM.gov active status does not establish Grants.gov, Research.gov, DSIP, JCP, CMMC, export, AOR, or final-submit authority.
FRE, ITAR, EAR, CUI, FCI, CMMC, cost allowability, data rights, conflicts, and corporate certifications remain human or qualified-review decisions.
Every generated finding is bound to source bytes and fails closed when a configured evidence check stops matching.
